`dsh-brand-deepseek` 是一个**纯第三方、自包含**的 DeepSeek Harness 客户端插件：通过 Harness 已公开的插槽系统，把 Web 客户端的侧边栏品牌与会话页标题替换成 DeepSeek 官方样式，**不需要改动 Harness 源码**。

- **侧边栏品牌** —— 鲸鱼标志加 `deepseek` 字标，默认填充官方 DeepSeek 蓝，另有 9 种颜色可选。
- **会话页标题** —— 空白会话页聊天框上方的标题行改为「鲸鱼标志 + 想从哪里开始?」，官方默认标题（探索未至之境 + 预览版徽章）隐藏。
- **随时可退回** —— 左下角 **设置 → 品牌样式** 可单独开关两处品牌；关闭后恢复 Harness 官方默认品牌（`DSH 本地构建` + 构建版本徽章）。

未启用（或关闭「自定义样式」）时，侧边栏显示 Harness 自带的 `DSH 本地构建` 品牌与构建版本徽章：

| 默认外观 | 启用插件后 |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |

「设置 → 品牌样式」里可以分别开关自定义样式、会话页标题、轨迹页签与更多操作按钮，并从 10 种品牌颜色中选择：

插件只占用 `sidebar.brand.mark`、`sidebar.brand.name` 与 `conversation.hero.brand.mark` 三个公开插槽，并以低于默认值的优先级注册，在官方构建里压过内置的 `ui-brand-official` 占位；具体机制见[工作原理](#工作原理)。

- **侧边栏品牌** —— 官方 DeepSeek 鲸鱼标志与字标，默认填充官方 DeepSeek 蓝。
- **会话页标题行** —— 开启后，空白会话聊天框上方的标题行改为 DeepSeek 品牌标题（鲸鱼标志 + 想从哪里开始?），官方默认标题（探索未至之境 + 预览版徽章）被隐藏、整行居中；关闭后回到官方默认标题。
- **品牌样式设置页**（左下角**设置 → 品牌样式**）：
  - **自定义样式**开关 —— 关闭即恢复官方默认品牌（`DSH 本地构建` / `DSH Local Build` + 构建版本徽章）：品牌插槽整体注销，由外壳回退渲染；
  - **会话页标题**开关 —— 独立切换标题行（默认开启）；
  - **轨迹页签**与 **更多操作按钮**开关 —— 独立显示/隐藏会话页头部这两处外壳元素（默认都开启），纯 DOM 层操作，不影响背后的轨迹数据与导出功能（「下载 Session 日志」就在「更多操作」菜单里）；
  - **十种品牌颜色**可选（当前配色 = 官方 DeepSeek 蓝，为默认项），选择后立即生效并写回 Host 配置，刷新后仍在。
- **实时预览** —— 设置页的预览区跟随两个状态渲染：自定义样式关闭时展示当前外壳回退品牌（鱼形标志、本地化标签与构建版本徽章）。
- **插件清单里的展示信息** —— 包内自带 `icon.svg`（品牌鲸鱼标志）与 `locale/en.json`、`locale/zh.json` 两份 `meta.title`/`meta.description`。Harness 的插件管理器、bundle 详情与**设置 → 插件**清单在**不激活插件**的前提下读取它们，因此插件行显示的是带图标的中英文名称与能力说明，而不是包名回退文本和默认占位图。见[工作原理](#工作原理)。

- Node.js `^22.19` 或 `>=24`
- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.3` 或兼容的 `0.2.1` 预发布版本，以及提供 `ctx.slots`、`ctx.configForms` 与 `ctx.locale` 的 **Web profile**
- 包内声明 `engines.dsh = ^0.2.1-rc.3`：Harness 的插件兼容性预检在**不加载插件代码**的前提下读取它（声明了 `engines.dsh` 时以它为准，`peerDependencies` 不再参与判定），版本不符时会给出明确的不兼容提示，而不是等到运行期出错
- Web profile 中需带有插件声明的客户端模块（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`、`-ui-sidebar`、`-ui-settings`、`-ui-renderer`、`-locale`、`dsh-api-remotes`）；默认 Web profile 已包含
- 产物不含任何指向 Harness checkout 的路径依赖

把已发布的包安装进自定义 Web profile。包内声明了 `dsh.bundle`，因此 `dsh plugin add` 会自动补上 `brand-deepseek` 这一行：

```sh
dsh --profile web-brand --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile web-brand add @linbin-mk/dsh-brand-deepseek
dsh --profile web-brand
```

改为安装本地构建的 tarball：

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build
pnpm test
npm pack

从同一个 profile 移除插件：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web-brand remove @linbin-mk/dsh-brand-deepseek
```

Host 半侧把品牌样式声明成本插件的 Cordis `Config`：五个字段全部 `.volatile()`，因此都是可在运行时改写的活配置，默认值如下。设置命名空间就是 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 loader 行 id `brand-deepseek`——它与包名（加载标识 `@linbin-mk/dsh-brand-deepseek`）**故意不同**，改包名不会让已有设置失效。客户端半侧通过 `ctx.configForms.get('brand-deepseek')` 读写该行的配置表单，写入由 Harness 的设置域做修订号保护与串行化，因此修改立即生效、无需重启 Harness。从 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 起所有已认证浏览器都通过 Host 配置文档持久化（客户端上「进程内存储」的 memory 模式已从 `ConfigFormSnapshot` 删除），因此只有当 Host 文档明确不接受写入或当前页面读不到该命名空间时，写入控件才整体禁用、不会假装已保存。

| 设置 | 默认值 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 自定义品牌样式总开关。关闭后品牌插槽被注销，侧边栏回到外壳的官方默认品牌。 |
| `hero` | `true` | 空白会话页标题行是否使用 DeepSeek 品牌标题。 |
| `trajectoryTab` | `true` | 会话页头部的「轨迹」页签是否可见（轨迹数据不受影响）。 |
| `sessionLogButton` | `true` | 会话页头部的「更多操作」菜单按钮是否可见（「下载 Session 日志」在该菜单里；导出功能不受影响）。 |
| `color` | `#4176e6` | 品牌颜色，十选一，官方蓝为默认。 |

- **Host 半侧**（`lib/index.js`）只做两件事：声明品牌样式的 Cordis `Config`（五个 `.volatile()` 字段，即设置命名空间 `brand-deepseek` 的全部内容），并为自己这一行声明 `{ auto: false }`——本插件自带设置页，不需要侧边栏「插件」列表再自动生成一个。
- **目标版本声明** —— `package.json` 的 `engines.dsh` 声明本插件面向的 DSH 范围（`^0.2.1-rc.3`，与 DSH peer 依赖同一行）；`scripts/smoke-client.mjs` 断言两者一致，避免「依赖升了、声明没升」的漂移。Harness 的插件兼容性预检读取该字段时不需要加载插件代码。
- **品牌插槽的优先级（压过而不是抢占）** —— 插槽注册表对同一个 `single` 单元只允许**每个优先级**一个占位，并渲染优先级**最低**的那个；在同一优先级重复注册会抛错。内置的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-brand-official` 以默认优先级 `0` 占用 `sidebar.brand.mark` 与 `sidebar.brand.name`，且它发布出去的 bundle 已经把 `DSH_CLIENT_BUILD_PROFILE` 构建开关**编译掉**了，所以**每个 official 构建都会真正注册这两个占位**。本插件若按默认优先级注册，就会在 official 构建里被注册表拒绝（`single slot "…" already has a registration at priority 0`）：品牌留在内置占位上，设置页每次读取都报这个错。因此三个品牌插槽统一用 `priority: -1` 注册：自定义样式开启时稳稳压过内置占位，关闭时注销自身、把同一个单元**交还**给内置占位（没有内置占位的本地构建则回退到外壳品牌）。
- **客户端半侧**（`lib/client.js`）是一个由 tsdown 打包、以 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 自注册的 CJS bundle。`id` 必须等于**包名**——Harness 用入口名索引客户端模块表，名字不一致时该行解析失败、整个 GUI 起不来（而 `--dump-config` 仍显示正常）。`tsdown.config.ts` 直接从 `package.json` 取 `name` 写进 banner，`scripts/smoke-client.mjs` 再断言一次两者相等，因此重命名不会静默漂移。
- **插件清单的展示信息**由 `readPluginMeta`（`dsh-app

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build         # src/ -> lib/（lib/ 已提交，安装后无需构建）
pnpm build:check   # 重新构建并断言 lib/ 与提交内容一致
pnpm test          # 七个冒烟测试

`pnpm test` 依次跑：`scripts/smoke-client.mjs`（按浏览器加载器的真实方式加载 `lib/client.js`，断言 bundle id == 包名、导出与 `inject` 契约）、`scripts/smoke-host.mjs`（加载 `lib/index.js`，断言五个字段都是 volatile、默认值正确，且 Host 半侧以**自己的 fiber** 注册 `{ auto: false }`）、`scripts/smoke-visibility.mjs`（在 jsdom 里按 `0.2.1-rc.3` 的真实头部标记挂载 `apply()`，验证两个持久化开关驱动 DOM，包括重挂载后的观察者补偿、`aria-label` 兜底定位、`0.1.5-alpha.2` 之前那个「Session 日志」文字按钮仍被识别，以及 `0.2.1-rc.3` 新增的「更多会话视图」按钮不会被误隐藏）、`scripts/smoke-config.mjs`（用假的配置表单挂载 `apply()`，验证按行 id `brand-deepseek` 取表单、读到的配置驱动运行时、开关经 `form.set` 写回、Host 拒绝写入或页面不可写时不假装已保存）、`scripts/smoke-shadowing.mjs`（用**真实**的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots` 注册表预置内置品牌占位，验证本插件压过它而不是抛错、关掉自定义样式后交还给它、同优先级注册确实会抛错，且没有内置占位的构建里仍然渲染鲸鱼标志）、`scripts/smoke-locators.mjs`（对已发布的 `-ui-conversation`、`-ui-trajectory`、`dsh-session-log-export` bundle 逐个校验在用的类名/文案定位点，要求源码里的每个定位点都已在表里登记，并把本地 master 新增的 ja/es/fr/de/ru/pt 六种语言文案按「已在源码登记」单独校验）与 `scripts/smoke-metadata.mjs`（按 Harness 的解析规则校验 `./locale/*.json` 与 `./icon`，含语言 id 文件名、非空标题描述、图标格式与 256 KiB 上限、`exports`/`files` 双声明，以及图标与侧边栏同一条鲸鱼路径）。jsdom 只是本包的开发依赖，运行时不需要。

- **侧边栏没有任何变化。** 先确认插件行还在（这一步只覆盖 Host 半侧；客户端半侧的失败只在浏览器控制台里暴露）：

```sh
  dsh --profile web-brand --dump-config | grep -A 2 brand-deepseek
  ```

再打开浏览器控制台：客户端 bundle 的加载错误会直接打在这里。
- **页面显示 `Failed to load plugins`。** Harness 用**包名**索引客户端模块表，bundle 注册的 `id` 必须是同一个字符串。本仓库用构建期派生 + 冒烟测试断言把这个约束固定住了；如果你在 fork 里改了包名，请一并重建 `lib/`（`pnpm build`），不要手改 `lib/client.js`。
- **刚发版后 `dsh plugin add` 报 404。** 全新版本在 registry 读路径上需要几分钟才可见；`dist-tags` 与元数据通常先可用。稍后重试即可，不要重复发布。
- **通过镜像安装报 `ERR_PNPM_FETCH_404`。** npmmirror 等镜像同步新版本有自己的节奏。给这条命令加上 `--registry=https://registry.npmjs.org`，或等镜像同步。
- **pnpm 拒绝或询问刚发布的版本。** 这是 pnpm 的 `minimumReleaseAge` 延迟保护。放行该包（pnpm 会记录到 `minimumReleaseAgeExclude`）或等过这个时间窗口。
- **官方 profile 下的品牌。** 内置的 `ui-brand-official` 在 official 构建里确实注册同样两个侧边栏插槽（它发布出去的 bundle 已经编译掉构建开关）。本插件用 `priority: -1` 注册，所以开启时**压过**它、关闭时把插槽交还给它——不再有「同优先级抢占而抛错」的风险。想让别的插件再压过本插件，用比 `-1` 更低的优先级注册即可。
- **标题行出现两个标题（品牌标题与官方标题并排）。** 说明当前 Harness 又改掉了标题行的 CSS Module 局部名，插件按设计退化而不是报错。提 issue 时附上 Harness 版本和那个 `<hash>_xxx` 局部名即可。
- **隐藏的页签或按钮又出现了。** 观察者会在重挂载后重新应用；只有类名后缀与本地化文案（含 `aria-label`）**同时**变化时插件才放弃隐藏（宁可保持可见，也不误隐藏别的元素）。
插件不发起任何网络请求、不读取会话内容、不上报遥测。它只做三件事：注册插槽占位、读写本插件 `brand-deepseek` 这一行的配置、在会话页头部按设置隐藏两个 DOM 元素（轨迹页签、头部「更多操作」菜单按钮）。设置值保存在 Harness 的 profile 配置里，不离开本机。隐藏元素只影响渲染，轨迹数据与「下载 Session 日志」功能不受影响。

`dsh-brand-deepseek` is a **third-party, self-contained** DeepSeek Harness client plugin: through the harness's documented slot system it gives the Web client the official DeepSeek brand in the sidebar and above the chat box, **without patching the harness source**.

- **Sidebar brand** — the whale mark plus the `deepseek` wordmark, filled with the official DeepSeek blue by default; nine more colors are available.
- **Hero headline** — a blank session's title row above the chat box becomes whale mark + 想从哪里开始?, with the official default headline (探索未至之境 + the 预览版 badge) hidden.
- **Always reversible** — **Settings → Brand style** toggles each piece independently; turning it off restores the harness default brand (`DSH 本地构建` + build-version badge).

Without the plugin (or with "Custom style" off), the sidebar shows the harness's built-in `DSH 本地构建` brand and build-version badge:

| Default | With the plugin |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |

**Settings → Brand style** toggles the custom style, the hero headline, the trajectory tab and the more-actions button, and offers ten brand colors:

The plugin only fills the three public slots `sidebar.brand.mark`, `sidebar.brand.name` and `conversation.hero.brand.mark`, registering below the default priority so it shadows the shipped `ui-brand-official` occupant in an official build; see [How it works](#how-it-works).

- Node.js `^22.19` or `>=24`
- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.3` or a compatible `0.2.1` prerelease, on a **Web profile** that provides `ctx.slots`, `ctx.configForms` and `ctx.locale`
- The package declares `engines.dsh = ^0.2.1-rc.3`: the harness plugin-compatibility preflight reads it **without loading plugin code** (when `engines.dsh` is present it decides alone and `peerDependencies` are ignored), so a version mismatch surfaces as an explicit incompatibility warning instead of a runtime failure
- The client modules the plugin declares (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`, `-ui-sidebar`, `-ui-settings`, `-ui-renderer`, `-locale`, `dsh-api-remotes`) — the default Web profile already ships them
- No path dependency on a Harness checkout

Install the published package into a custom Web profile. The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so `dsh plugin add` also inserts the `brand-deepseek` row automatically:

```sh
dsh --profile web-brand --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile web-brand add @linbin-mk/dsh-brand-deepseek
dsh --profile web-brand
```

Or install a locally built tarball:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build
pnpm test
npm pack

Remove it from the same profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web-brand remove @linbin-mk/dsh-brand-deepseek
```

The host half declares the brand style as this plugin's Cordis `Config`: all five fields are `.volatile()`, so every one of them is live-editable, with the defaults below. The settings namespace is the loader row id `brand-deepseek` from `cordis.patch.yml` — **deliberately not the package name**, which is the loader identity (`@linbin-mk/dsh-brand-deepseek`); renaming the package does not invalidate existing settings. The client half reads and writes that row's configuration form through `ctx.configForms.get('brand-deepseek')`, and the harness settings domain owns revision fencing and write serialization, so changes take effect immediately with no restart. Since DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` every authenticated browser persists through the Host configuration document (the client-side in-process "memory" mode was removed from `ConfigFormSnapshot`), so write controls are disabled — instead of pretending to save — only when the Host document does not accept writes or the page cannot read the namespace.

| Setting | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch for the custom brand. Off unregisters the brand slots, returning the sidebar to the shell's official default brand. |
| `hero` | `true` | Whether the blank-session title row uses the DeepSeek brand title. |
| `trajectoryTab` | `true` | Whether the conversation header's "Trajectory" tab is visible (trajectory data is unaffected). |
| `sessionLogButton` | `true` | Whether the conversation header's "More actions" menu button is visible (it holds "Download session log"; export still works). |
| `color` | `#4176e6` | Brand color, one of ten; official blue is the default. |

- The **host half** (`lib/index.js`) does two things: it declares the brand-style Cordis `Config` (five `.volatile()` fields — the whole of the `brand-deepseek` settings namespace) and registers `{ auto: false }` for its own row, since the plugin ships its own settings page and the sidebar Plugins list must not generate a second one.
- **Declared target** — `package.json#engines.dsh` states the DSH range this plugin targets (`^0.2.1-rc.3`, the same line as the DSH peer dependencies); `scripts/smoke-client.mjs` asserts the two agree, so a dependency bump cannot drift away from the declaration. The harness compatibility preflight reads that field without loading any plugin code.
- **Brand-slot priority (shadow, do not compete)** — the slot registry allows one occupant per cell **per priority** and renders the **lowest**; a second registration at the same priority throws. The shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-brand-official` occupies `sidebar.brand.mark` and `sidebar.brand.name` at the default priority `0`, and its published bundle has the `DSH_CLIENT_BUILD_PROFILE` build switch **compiled away**, so it really does register those occupants in every official build. A default-priority

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build         # src/ -> lib/ (lib/ is committed; installs need no build step)
pnpm build:check   # rebuild and assert lib/ matches what is committed
pnpm test          # seven smoke tests

`pnpm test` runs `scripts/smoke-client.mjs` (loads `lib/client.js` the way the browser loader does, asserting bundle id == package name plus the export and `inject` contract), `scripts/smoke-host.mjs` (loads `lib/index.js` and asserts all five fields are volatile with the documented defaults, and that the host half registers `{ auto: false }` for its **own fiber**), `scripts/smoke-visibility.mjs` (mounts `apply()` on a jsdom document carrying the real `0.2.1-rc.3` header markup and verifies that both persisted toggles drive the DOM, including the observer re-apply after a remount, the `aria-label` fallback locator, the pre-`0.1.5-alpha.2` "Session log" text button still being recognized, and the new `0.2.1-rc.3` "More conversation views" launcher not being hidden by mistake), `scripts/smoke-config.mjs` (mounts `apply()` over a fake configuration form and verifies that the form is fetched by the `brand-deepseek` row id, that the accepted section drives the runtime, that toggles write through `form.set`, and that a refused write or a non-writable page never pretends to save), `scripts/smoke-shadowing.mjs` (wires the bundle to the **real** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots` registry w

- **The sidebar does not change.** First confirm the plugin row is still installed (this only covers the host half; a client-half failure surfaces in the browser console):

```sh
  dsh --profile web-brand --dump-config | grep -A 2 brand-deepseek
  ```

Then open the browser console: client bundle loading errors are printed there.
- **The page shows `Failed to load plugins`.** The harness indexes its client module table by **package name**, and the bundle's registered `id` must be that same string. This repository pins the constraint with a build-time derivation plus a smoke-test assertion; if you rename the package in a fork, rebuild `lib/` (`pnpm build`) rather than editing `lib/client.js` by hand.
- **`dsh plugin add` returns 404 right after a release.** A brand-new version takes a few minutes to appear on the registry's read path; `dist-tags` and metadata usually appear first. Retry later — do not republish.
- **`ERR_PNPM_FETCH_404` when installing through a mirror.** Mirrors such as npmmirror sync new versions on their own schedule. Add `--registry=https://registry.npmjs.org` to that command, or wait for the mirror.
- **pnpm refuses or questions a just-published version.** That is pnpm's `minimumReleaseAge` delay. Allow the package (pnpm records it in `minimumReleaseAgeExclude`) or wait out the window.
- **Brand conflict under an official profile.** The in-box `ui-brand-official` package really does occupy those two sidebar s

The plugin makes no network requests, reads no conversation content and reports no telemetry. It does three things only: register slot occupants, read and write the `brand-deepseek` configuration row, and hide two DOM elements in the conversation header (the trajectory tab and the header "More actions" menu button) according to your settings. Values live in the harness profile configuration and never leave the machine. Hiding affects rendering only — trajectory data and "Download session log" are untouched.

The sidebar whale mark and the `DeepSeek` wordmark are copied unmodified from the brand SVG in the header of the DeepSeek website (deepseek.com).
